name: priprema-za-intervju-week-2-starter
description: AI Bootcamp Week 2 starter sa read-only Upstash tokom i kontrolisanim build, config i deployment zadatkom.

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/copy-static.mjs && node scripts/check-dist.mjs
scripts.verify:starter: npm run check && node scripts/check-starter.mjs && node scripts/verify-local.mjs --summary-status=501
scripts.verify:solution: npm run test && node scripts/check-solution.mjs && npm run build && node scripts/verify-local.mjs --summary-status=200
scripts.check: npm run test && npm run build
